label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter outlines read instantly as a dagger (diamond blade, upswept crescent guard with ball finials, bulb pommel); silhouette render is clean, and the top view still reads as guard plus blade cross-section; A15 X/Y error 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: blade is the big mass, the crescent guard and pommel are medium, and the finial balls, gold grip bands and pommel collar are small details.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: short wide blade with a long faceted tip, an oversized upswept guard and a chunky pommel; guard is centred (alignment offset 0.0), every seat is reported seated, and no float or sink is visible.
evidence.V4: Inconsistent: the guard has clear chamfers that catch light and the blade has edge flats, but the pommel collar ring and grip bands have razor-hard rims with no visible chamfer (pommel studio close-up).
evidence.V5: Minor: the pommel ball and collar show polygonal faceting on the outline (about 8 visible sides in the pommel flat close-up), and the narrow neck between collar and ball reads as a dark seam; blade, tip and guard shade clean.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, two steel-grey values with a darker fuller line, and one grip hue (teal) used only in the bands; good value contrast.
evidence.V7: 2412 tris against a weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000): at target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours; gold, steel and single-hue grip bands match the kit and the Scimitar anchor's grip and pommel language; all colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the grip hue.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Tool Handle, origin at the grip point, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel ball and collar: low-segment faceting visible on the silhouette edge in the close-ups
Pommel neck between collar and ball reads as a dark seam or gap in the studio light
Collar ring and grip bands have hard unchamfered rims, unlike the bevelled guard
top_fixes: Add segments (or smooth the profile) on the pommel ball and collar so the outline reads round, not octagonal, at close range
Chamfer the pommel collar and grip-band rims (~0.045 studs) to match the guard's bevels
Fill in or soften the narrow neck between collar and pommel ball so it doesn't read as a dark seam
